## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Identify the baseline and target branch.

## Verification

List relevant checks and their results. Distinguish offline mocks, previews, and production evidence.

## Limits and review

Record known issues, data/schema effects, and rollback steps when applicable.

- [ ] Documentation, code comments, commit messages, and GitHub notes are in English.
- [ ] Examples use fictional data; no secrets or research records are included.

- [ ] Production merge/deployment is left for Juanxi's explicit approval.
